result.summary: The page appears mostly functional, but one notable visual issue was identified related to text truncation.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' appears to be cut off in the card title — it renders as 'Tokumaru Ramer' with what looks like a clipped 'n', suggesting a font rendering or text clipping issue at the end of the label.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the text container for restaurant names has sufficient width and proper overflow handling (e.g., ellipsis or wrapping) to avoid characters being visually clipped or misrendered.
